Challenge the finding and decide narration transcript

Synthetic narration of the reference lesson. This is not a recorded ChatGPT build session.

A mixed business picture

Run Prompt four. Ask ChatGPT to challenge the conclusion rather than simply endorse an increase in spending. Revenue and transacting customers grew between May and June. Acquisition cost rose, activation fell and contribution margin weakened. Those observations can coexist. Separate the facts you verified from your explanation of them. The incident narrative offers context, but it does not prove that an incident caused activation to fall or that more spending caused reliability to worsen.

The spending illustration

Set June, All origins, and move the spending control to twenty percent. Twenty percent of the six hundred and sixty thousand ringgit baseline adds one hundred and thirty-two thousand ringgit per month. With acquisition cost fixed at sixty-six ringgit, that buys two thousand hypothetical additional verified customers. With activation fixed at thirty-eight percent, seven hundred and sixty activate. Check the zero-change position as well. When the baseline inputs are valid, it should show zero incremental spending and zero additional customers.

What the illustration omits

The arithmetic does not know whether acquisition efficiency will remain constant at a higher budget. It does not model retention, lifetime value, fraud, capacity or the cost and benefit of improving the product. It is an incremental monthly illustration used to inform a quarterly discussion, not a forecast of quarterly earnings. The purpose is to expose the assumption so you can ask what evidence would support it. Do not treat a precise-looking number as greater certainty than the input assumptions justify.

Your recommendation

A defensible recommendation might hold the broad increase, approve a capped experiment or stage an increase after defined improvements. Choose the action yourself. Cite two observations, state the strongest counterargument and identify missing evidence. For example, a hold could miss an acquisition opportunity while revenue is growing. A controlled experiment might address that concern. Name a condition that would change your mind, and make its owner explicit. Pause now and prepare those elements before asking ChatGPT to write the decision brief.
